title: Strange World
author: Matt Salaiz
description: In this very easy, very signposted, and very minimalist escape game, you play as a pilot who was flying a F16 over the Pacific Ocean. After a flash of light, you found yourself crash-landed here in a patchwork land where a blizzard, a desert, and a rainforest co-exist beside each other. Find your lost equipment, then escape this strange world.
